name: Mixed-e4-seven-notes-four-rejected
notes: Seven E4 notes: quarter, half, quarter, half, whole, whole, whole. Notes 1,3,5,6 get no proposal: filled heads and two whole heads rejected on margin, and stem 2 rejected on geometry. Strokes 6 and 8 were relabeled noteheadFilled -> stem after review (they are the stems of notes 3 and 4). Recorder note: Notes 1,3,5,6 fail.
